standard_definition.en: Context-sensitive teaching goals for a comfortable, coordinated and controllable stationary practice shot. Natural individual form may differ. A single shot does not prove a habitual fault or repeatability.
standard_definition.zh: 以舒适、协调、可控制的定点练习投篮为教学目标；允许自然的个人动作差异。单次投篮不能证明习惯性错误或重复稳定性。

global_rules: Issue observations must describe a specific visible event and cite supplied frame IDs. Missing visibility is a limitation, not a player fault.
Use at most three supported issues, ranked by review priority then evidence confidence. Do not invent a minimum number of issues or an overall technique score.
No universal ideal joint angles, mandatory release height, minimum hold duration, or celebrity-pose similarity score.
Do not infer make/miss, miss direction, force, ball spin or a cause of a miss from body pose.
A motion after release cannot change the ball already in flight. Finish advice is an optional practice cue.
Higher-priority model observations remain provisional. No high-severity diagnosis is accepted without a coach-confirmed workflow.
Do not describe one attempt as consistent, repeatable across shots, improved or a habit. Use observed single-attempt language.
Numbers displayed in measurements are program-computed. Do not invent or restate measurement numbers in model prose; practical drill counts are allowed.
A single selected personal reference is not a validated good shot and model coaching sees no reference video.
Suggested drill counts are product proposals for a short practice trial, not dosages validated by the cited teaching sources.
Review every dimension, including small but actionable deviations; do not reserve issues only for a stumble or interrupted arm extension.
An aligned judgment requires positive evidence for the applicable checks. Absence of an obvious breakdown alone is insufficient.
For every dimension inspect setup, movement and completion where applicable; state which check cannot be assessed. Return all dimensions in coverage.
A missed shot is useful outcome feedback, but it does not prove a specific movement fault. Ball-flight or hoop observations must be separately evidenced; do not infer them from pose.
Describe observed deviations, plausible consequences and testable practice cues separately. Do not force problems to satisfy a quota.

teaching_goal.en: Let the lower-body rise and ball lift connect comfortably into the release, allowing individual one-motion or two-motion styles.
teaching_goal.zh: 让下肢起身、举球与出手舒适衔接，允许个人采用一段式或两段式动作。

required_evidence: continuous visible hips or knees, ball and shooting arm from load to release
a specific visible sequencing deviation assessed in shooting context, not just a measured phase length
do_not_infer: A slow or long measured phase alone is not poor rhythm.
A two-motion pause alone is not a fault.
Wrist and hip timing does not establish force transfer.

suggested_drill.en: Try two sets of five comfortable close-range shots with one cue: let the rise and ball lift flow together. Compare the release sequence with the original clip.
suggested_drill.zh: 试做两组、每组 5 次舒适距离近投，只想一个提示：起身与举球自然衔接。再与原片比较出手前的动作顺序。

practice_check.en: Check whether the specific stop or restart is reduced without forcing a new rhythm. Judge across the set, not from one make.
practice_check.zh: 看原来可见的停顿或重启是否减少，同时保持舒适节奏。看整组表现，不靠一球投进就下结论。

review_checks: Locate the final shooting load, excluding walking, catching and dribbling earlier in the clip.
Inspect the order of leg extension, ball lift and release, and any late restart or compensatory push.

teaching_goal.en: Finish the stationary practice shot with a comfortably controlled landing; a natural forward drift does not itself violate this goal.
teaching_goal.zh: 定点练习投篮后能够舒适、可控地落地；自然向前移动本身并不违背这个目标。

required_evidence: feet and trunk continuously visible through landing
specific trunk, support or recovery behavior across takeoff and landing, not ordinary drift alone
do_not_infer: Do not demand takeoff and landing on precisely the same spot.
One landing cannot establish consistency across shots.
Camera-relative displacement is not validated body balance.

suggested_drill.en: Try five comfortable close-range shots. After each, notice whether you can finish in control without an extra recovery step; allow your natural landing position.
suggested_drill.zh: 试做 5 次舒适距离近投，每次留意落地后能否自然站稳、无需额外找平衡；允许自然的落地点变化。

practice_check.en: Compare the visible recovery movement across the set from the same fixed camera. Do not grade ordinary forward sway as an error.
practice_check.zh: 用同一固定机位比较这组是否仍需额外找平衡，不把普通向前移动当作错误。

review_checks: Compare trunk orientation and foot support before takeoff, at release and at landing.
Inspect abrupt trunk changes, asymmetric recovery and extra corrective steps; allow controlled natural forward travel.

teaching_goal.en: Complete a comfortable shooting-arm extension into release without imposing an exact elbow angle or a universal release height.
teaching_goal.zh: 让出手臂舒适地伸展并完成离手，不强求固定肘角或所有人相同的出手高度。

required_evidence: clear shoulder, elbow, wrist and ball in several frames around separation
clear observed release sequence, including direction changes or hand adjustments when visible
do_not_infer: Wrist height is not ball release height.
A low hand position alone is not an error.
Projected elbow angle is not a validated 3-D angle.
Never force elbow lockout.

suggested_drill.en: Try five close-range form shots, letting the shooting arm extend comfortably toward the target. Review the hand and ball together around release; do not force the elbow straight.
suggested_drill.zh: 试做 5 次近距离定型投篮，让出手臂舒适地向目标伸展，回看离手附近手与球的关系，不要强行锁死肘关节。

practice_check.en: See whether the specific interruption becomes less visible while the motion stays comfortable. Compare release frames at the same distance and angle.
practice_check.zh: 看之前具体可见的中断是否减少，动作是否仍然舒适；在同距离、同角度下比较离手附近画面。

review_checks: Inspect continuity and direction of the shooting-arm extension and wrist completion across separation.
Check for a visible abrupt reroute, re-grip or premature braking; distinguish these from an individually chosen release height.

teaching_goal.en: Use the guide hand to support the ball while the shooting hand completes the release. A visible push or twist is a review hypothesis, not proof of force or spin.
teaching_goal.zh: 辅助手负责支撑，让出手手完成离球。可见的推拨或转动只能作为复核线索，不能证明实际用力或球的旋转。

required_evidence: both hands and ball individually discernible at separation
close clear frames showing a specific guide-hand movement
do_not_infer: Wide-angle pose landmarks alone cannot establish guide-hand interference.
Do not infer ball spin, applied force or miss direction.

suggested_drill.en: At a comfortable close distance, try five one-hand form shots, then five with the guide hand lightly supporting the ball. Record a close view of both hands at release.
suggested_drill.zh: 在舒适近距离先试 5 次单手定型投篮，再试 5 次辅助手轻扶球的投篮，拍清两只手在离球时的动作。

practice_check.en: Compare the visible support-hand movement in the two sets. Keep the result a hypothesis until the hands are clearly visible.
practice_check.zh: 比较两组可见的辅助手动作，只有看清双手后再确认，先把判断当作待验证的线索。

review_checks: Inspect guide-hand position before separation and the sequence of its withdrawal.
Report a visible push-like motion as a review hypothesis only when hand/ball detail resolves it; a raised hand after separation alone proves no interference.

teaching_goal.en: In comfortable close-range practice, finish the release and briefly retain a relaxed shooting-hand position so the motion is easy to review. There is no required hold time.
teaching_goal.zh: 在舒适的近投练习中完整完成离手，稍留放松的收势，方便回看动作；不规定必须保持几秒。

required_evidence: continuous visible shooting arm after release
a clearly observed early sustained withdrawal, not small projection noise
do_not_infer: Post-release movement does not change the ball in flight.
A lowering percentage or hold time is not a validated fault threshold.
This is low-priority optional practice, never a high-severity diagnosis.

suggested_drill.en: Try five comfortable near-basket shots. Complete the release, briefly leave a relaxed finish, and compare the motion around release with the original clip.
suggested_drill.zh: 试做 5 次舒适的近筐投篮，完整完成离手，轻松保留收势片刻；再与原片比较离手附近的动作。

practice_check.en: Check whether the finish is comfortable and easier to observe across the set. Do not use hold time or a single make as proof of better shooting.
practice_check.zh: 看这组收势是否舒适、是否更容易观察；不把保持时长或一次命中当作技术改善的证明。

review_checks: Inspect completion through separation separately from later arm lowering.
Check whether visible wrist and arm finish make the release repeatable to inspect; do not infer muscle tension or require a fixed hold duration.

teaching_goal.en: Establish a stable, ready base before lifting the ball.
teaching_goal.zh: 举球前建立稳定、准备充分的支撑。

review_checks: Are the feet set and the load coordinated before the shooting lift?
Is there a visible late foot reset, unstable support or abrupt trunk adjustment?
required_evidence: feet, knees and trunk visible before the shooting lift
do_not_infer: Do not prescribe one foot angle or stance width for everyone.
Do not infer weight distribution or force from projected pose alone.

suggested_drill.en: Compare comfortable close-range shots with the feet ready before starting the lift.
suggested_drill.zh: 近距离练习时，先站稳并准备好双脚，再开始举球。

practice_check.en: Review whether the specific observed deviation changes without forcing discomfort.
practice_check.zh: 复看所指出的具体偏差是否变化，避免强迫不舒适的动作。

teaching_goal.en: Bring the ball into a controllable shooting position with an economical visible path.
teaching_goal.zh: 通过可控、简洁的举球路径进入出手位置。

review_checks: Track the ball from the final preparation to the set point and release.
Inspect a pronounced lateral loop, late re-grip or path correction; allow a natural dip.
required_evidence: ball and both arms visible across preparation and lift
do_not_infer: An individual dip or set point alone is not a fault.
Do not judge depth from a single oblique projection.

suggested_drill.en: Record slow close-range shots and compare the ball path into the shooting position.
suggested_drill.zh: 拍摄慢节奏近投，比较球进入出手位置的路线。

practice_check.en: Review whether the specific observed deviation changes without forcing discomfort.
practice_check.zh: 复看所指出的具体偏差是否变化，避免强迫不舒适的动作。

teaching_goal.en: Organize the shooting forearm, wrist and ball to extend toward the target.
teaching_goal.zh: 让出手前臂、手腕和球形成朝目标伸展的关系。

review_checks: Inspect the elbow under/behind the ball and the forearm/wrist relationship at the set point.
Check for a clear lateral sweep or last-moment correction through release, respecting camera projection.
required_evidence: shooting elbow, wrist and ball individually visible across set and release
do_not_infer: An apparent elbow offset in an oblique view alone is insufficient.
Do not invent an exact angle or infer force/ball spin.

suggested_drill.en: Use a front and side recording of comfortable close-range form shots to compare the arm and ball path.
suggested_drill.zh: 从正面和侧面拍摄舒适近投，对照出手臂与球的路线。

practice_check.en: Review whether the specific observed deviation changes without forcing discomfort.
practice_check.zh: 复看所指出的具体偏差是否变化，避免强迫不舒适的动作。

teaching_goal.en: Coordinate ball separation with the chosen shot rhythm and body extension.
teaching_goal.zh: 让离球时机与所采用的投篮节奏和身体伸展相协调。

review_checks: Locate takeoff, rising/descending movement and separation where visible.
Inspect a late compensatory release or a visible stop and restart; compare similar attempts before inferring a pattern.
required_evidence: continuous legs, trunk, ball and arm through separation
do_not_infer: Release at one universal point of the jump is not required.
One-motion and two-motion styles can both be functional; timing alone is not a fault.

suggested_drill.en: Compare the release sequence in a short set of comfortable shots at the same distance.
suggested_drill.zh: 在相同距离拍摄一小组舒适投篮，对照离球与身体伸展的先后关系。

practice_check.en: Review whether the specific observed deviation changes without forcing discomfort.
practice_check.zh: 复看所指出的具体偏差是否变化，避免强迫不舒适的动作。
